name: Kinetics-600 (Video Prediction Use)
summary: 动作视频在 Video Diffusion Models 中用于以 5 帧为条件预测后续 11 帧。
summaryEn: Action videos used by Video Diffusion Models to predict eleven future frames conditioned on five frames.
scale: Scope and version specified in the reviewed source; no pooled total asserted

access: Paper documents the resource; complete download not tested

wmNote: 2018 是数据年份，预测协议来自 2022 年论文；类别标签不是物理控制命令。
wmNoteEn: A published forward-prediction protocol conditions on five frames and predicts the next eleven. This justifies the prediction use of the video corpus, not treating action-category labels as motor commands.

evidence.statement: A published forward-prediction protocol conditions on five frames and predicts the next eleven. This justifies the prediction use of the video corpus, not treating action-category labels as motor commands.
